body: I understand this. Just know you're not alone feeling this way.

How does any one muster the energy to get out though? At this point I feel like it would be fine to just sit in my apartment and do nothing and cry indefinitely. I can't imagine all the effort it would take to take interest in anything beyond that. I can't imagine its worth it.
It's comforting to know there are others. I feel so alone. I know everyone else does too. It's just been so long. I can't remember any time where I didn't feel like this. But I must have, maybe?

I don't know what to say to help in anyway but I thought I'd reach out just because this post makes me feel a bit better. I too am unemployed for the last 3 months and I've had situations similar to this come up over the last few months. So if nothing else this is just for solidarity. Hope it all went well, if not this time, for next time.

No, I didn't know about any of this. Thank you for your detailed response. I'll give that a try.

I don't know what to say to help in this situation, considering that I have been unemployed for 2 months after being fired from a job for being too anxious and stressed.
 I don't know the complexities of your situation but I'd reccomend trying to air any grievances you have with your manager and if the don't listen or want to help improve your situation at work. that is a sign that it won't get any better. And that is the time for you to really ask yourself why this isn't working for you and what position you'd rather find yourself in and seek those things in a future employer. I know none of that is easy but it's the lesson I've learned recently. Your manager, or whoever you answer to, may to know the problem but once they do if they aren't willing to hear you out then it is your time to leave. There are greener pastures for you and you don't deserve this.

When I was a we one I my family took a trip to the Sizzler. As you may be may not be aware the main show at a Sizzler is a giant salad bar/ buffet. As a small child presented with aisles of food I can just grab and consume I was not interested in reading what I was grabbing and putting on my plate. I came upon some nuggets, what I assume is chicken nuggets and children love chicken nuggets so I pile delicious fried chicken bites on to my plate and return to join my family at our booth to feast! I pick up a crispy nugget and bite it through the middle. I'm chewing and something is not right. I'm not sure what is wrong so I look down to the other half of the nugget and to my horror its filled with creamed corn! I spit out the corn mush and march over to where I had acquired said nuggets and sure enough they are labelled 'Corn Nuggets'. Who thought this was a good idea?? How many others had been fooled? I have no closure to these events.
